The main takeaway from our work is that
the majority of shareholders do want specific environmental information from companies but they do not want to see it in their annual report.
shareholders want more environmental information than they are currently getting, but they are willing to accept a range of disclosure options.

shareholders do not want to know much about a company's environmental performance, but when they do want to know, they want the information in the annual report, they want to know the impact of the company on the environment, and they are willing to pay a premium to invest in companies with a good environmental reputation.
